title: Budd Hopkins' abductees all drew the same symbol

tellings.quote: and he said I want you to draw what you see on the inside of the ship on the the table and they all drew the same symbol on the wall

plain: James Fox is a UFO investigator and filmmaker, and he tells of being with Budd Hopkins, a researcher in New York who worked with people who say they were taken aboard alien craft. Fox says that in the 2000s Hopkins asked a group of these people to draw what they had seen inside the ship, and they all drew the same symbol on the wall. If true, it would suggest they all saw the same real place rather than imagining it.
